body:
TF2Tools 6.0.2 fixes custom crosshairs stopping weapons from firing after the latest TF2 update, and adds a Maps page for downloading community maps. It also brings a built-in window title bar and many smaller fixes across the app.

## What's Changed

- **Crosshairs no longer stop weapons from firing.** After the latest TF2 update, a weapon with a custom crosshair could not shoot. Press Apply on the Crosshairs page once after updating to fix your weapons.
- **New Maps page:** search the community maps on serveme.tf and download one with a click. TF2Tools only removes maps it downloaded itself.
- **Edit an installed HUD** in the HUD Maker straight from its card.
- **HUD Maker:** zoom and pan the preview, drop a PNG onto the maker, and many previews now match the game more closely.
- **Built-in title bar** with the app icon, and each store's icon in its download ring.
- **Pages remember where you were:** the stores, the Activity Log, searches and unsaved edits stay when you switch pages.
- **One sound player** for the whole app.
- **Name clashes keep both items:** importing a HUD or crosshair with a taken name adds "(2)" instead of replacing it.
- **Profiles:** Install Anyway leaves skipped items installed, and a profile can't take a name another profile already has.
- **Windows:** TF2Tools 6 offers to remove the old TF2Tools 4.
- **Store pictures:** every GameBanana screenshot now shows, with its position under the carousel.
- Scrollbars on every page and list that scrolls, tooltips on every icon button, and plainer wording throughout.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/compare/v6.0.1...v6.0.2

## Downloads

| Platform | File |
| --- | --- |
| Windows x64 | [TF2Tools.exe](https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/releases/download/v6.0.2/TF2Tools.exe) |
| Linux x86_64 | [tf2tools_6.0.2_x86_64.AppImage](https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/releases/download/v6.0.2/tf2tools_6.0.2_x86_64.AppImage) for most Linux systems, or [tf2tools_6.0.2_amd64.deb](https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/releases/download/v6.0.2/tf2tools_6.0.2_amd64.deb) for Ubuntu and Debian |

Each file also has a copy with no version in its name, for links that always point at the latest release. Check a download with `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS`.

## Before you install

- **Windows:** Windows may show a blue box saying "Windows protected your PC". TF2Tools is free and not signed with a paid certificate, so Windows does not recognise it yet. Click "More info", then "Run anyway". Only do this for the file from this page. TF2Tools 6 installs next to TF2Tools 4. Once it works, you can remove TF2Tools 4 in Windows Settings > Apps.
- **Linux AppImage:** after downloading, right-click the file, open Properties, allow it to run as a program, then double-click it.
- **Linux .deb:** open it with your software installer and click Install.

## Updates

On Windows and with the AppImage, TF2Tools checks for new versions and installs them itself after checking their signature. The .deb does not update itself; get new versions from the [Releases page](https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/releases).
